Subject: Initial request — inference for regulated drug discovery / export controls + pricing

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Orion is evaluating Redwood for an internal drug-discovery inference pipeline that will run sequence similarity scoring and generative candidate proposals. A few items that will determine our procurement:

- Regulatory/export controls: some models will be used with datasets that include non-U.S. controlled biological data and collaborators in EMEA/APAC. We need to know if Redwood has any export-control restrictions or if particular models are restricted from cross-border serving.
- KYC/compliance evidence: our procurement team will need SOC 2 report, basic KYC on the account, and answers to a short export-control questionnaire (attached).
- Pricing: we are working to include Redwood in a multi-vendor contract. Given likely committed volume (est. $600k ARR first year), we have a request for a one-time onboarding credit and a 15% discount in year 1. Are exceptions possible?

I've attached our short export questionnaire and a procurement intake form. Can you loop in someone on your side for security/compliance and pricing? We have an internal deadline of Feb 25 to finalize vendor shortlists.

Thanks,
Ryan
Ryan Choi
Head of Security Engineering
Orion Biotech

Subject: Re: Initial request — inference for regulated drug discovery / export controls + pricing

Thanks Ryan — I reviewed the attached questionnaire. High-level responses:

1) Export controls/sanctions: Redwood's hosted model catalog includes both open-source and partner-provided models. We do not export controlled biological agents; however, certain partner models have cross-border restrictions tied to licensing. For Orion's use-case (on-prem/private deployment option preferred for cross-border work), we can offer Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem) which mitigates cross-border export risk because inference runs in customer-managed infra.

2) KYC & evidence: SOC 2 Type II is attached (Ben). For additional KYC, please send over the company KYC bundle. We also request the primary point-of-contact for audit and the legal entity that will sign.

3) Technical controls: we can enable dedicated capacity with pinning to approved model versions, restrict model downloads, and provide audit logs for token flows. We will need to confirm whether any third-party model licenses block on-prem usage.

The key outstanding items I need from Orion: completed export questionnaire (marked where private deployment requested), KYC bundle, and confirmation whether the data includes ITAR-controlled materials. If ITAR applies, we'll need export counsel sign-off.

I recommend Redwood Private for Orion's cross-border work and a dedicated capacity contract to satisfy isolation and audit requirements. Laura, please advise on pricing implications for Private + dedicated capacity plus the requested discount.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Initial request — inference for regulated drug discovery / export controls + pricing

Ryan — appreciate the timeline. A few notes on pricing and contract flexibility:

- For Private (VPC/on-prem) + Dedicated capacity we typically require a 12-month committed minimum; given your $600k ARR estimate we can model committed spend with stepped discounts.
- The 15% year-1 discount and onboarding credit are outside standard self-service tiers. I can approve up to a 7% strategic discount within Sales authority for deals above $250k ARR, but anything beyond that needs a deal-desk executive exception (please see attached internal pricing sheet).
- We can offer a one-time onboarding credit equivalent to one month of committed capacity for new private deployments, subject to contract language limiting resale and reverse engineering.

To proceed I need the following by Feb 18 so we can hit your Feb 25 shortlist date:
1) Confirmation of legal entity and primary signer (for contract routing)
2) KYC bundle and completed export questionnaire (marking Private deployment preference)
3) Confirmation you are agreeable to a 12-month committed minimum for dedicated capacity

If the customer confirms the 12-month commit and agrees to the onboarding credit + 7% discount, I will start the deal-desk exception workflow immediately and escalate the remaining 8% to finance/ops for exec review. Ben — please capture these items in the HubSpot deal and attach the KYC bundle to the record.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
